About our vision, story and team

Our vision

Our vision is to make Block Editor the ultimate no-code platform for both professional web designers and content creators.

By transforming the core block editor into a powerful, unified tool, we enhance core blocks with advanced features—making web design accessible, efficient, and collaborative.

We aspire to change perceptions and unlock the full potential of block editor, empowering a global community to embrace it as a powerful tool for both advanced web design and content creation.

We aim to expand Blockera capabilities to include modern web design tools, marketing tools, and AI-driven website creation—all within the block editor.

Through community collaboration and innovation, we aim to make advanced web design accessible to all, shaping the future of WordPress development.

Our story

Hey there — I’m Ali 👋

After 15 years of designing and developing websites, I’ve seen it all.

I’ve built sites for clients across industries, tinkered with countless tools, and relied heavily on WordPress page builders, custom codes, and even external site builders outside the WordPress ecosystem.

While those tools had their perks, they often came at a cost—performance issues, overly complicated interfaces, or being locked into proprietary ecosystems.

As much as I ❤️ WordPress, its block editor left me feeling stuck. Sure, it’s simple and fast, but for a professional web designer looking to craft advanced, responsive websites for clients, it felt too basic—like trying to paint a masterpiece with crayons.

I wanted something better. Something that would allow me to stay in WordPress, use its block editor, and still have access to all the advanced tools I needed to create stunning, functional websites.

A tool that embraced no-code freedom while offering full customization for block editor and core blocks.

I realized I wasn’t alone in this frustration. Designers, agencies, and developers like me craved an advanced mode for the WordPress block editor—a way to unlock its full potential without abandoning its core simplicity.

That’s why we created Blockera

Blockera is more than just a plugin; it’s a vision for the future of WP block editor.

It bridges the gap between simplicity and power, allowing you to create professional websites right inside the block editor.

No clunky page builders, No bloated code, No duplicate blocks, No new interface. Just empowered WordPress block editor and unified user interface for designing site, creating forms, creating store... and content creation. All deeply integrated by generative AI.

Whether you’re building for yourself, your clients, or your business, Blockera is here to help you do it better, faster, and smarter.

Also, check out the roadmap and feature requests to understand the future of Blockera.

Welcome to the next level of WordPress block editor.
